It's hard to put into words what's been happening, and honestly, it’s been going on for over a year and a half now. There’s this client, a really successful  one, who I just know is secretly in love with me. I see the way he looks at me; he’s trying to tell me things without actually saying them, sending me signals through the properties he asks to see. It feels very real, though my husband thinks I’m imagining things.

Sometimes, it’s like my brain just can’t keep up. I'll open my mouth to talk about a listing, and the words come out all jumbled, a real "word salad" as my assistant put it once, confusing everyone, including myself. Other times, someone will ask me a direct question about a contract, and I just… can’t respond. It's not that I don't hear them, it’s like there’s a wall, and I just offer up this blank stare.

Lately, I've been crying a lot. The tears just come, out of nowhere, at the most inconvenient times, even when we’re showing a house. My husband says I’m just not myself. It takes me forever to fall asleep, and even then, I just lie there, replaying things and hearing whispers that aren’t really there, commenting on everything. My energy is so low, and I just feel flat inside, like I can’t connect with my emotions anymore. It's really affecting my work and my home life.

It’s been pretty rough lately, doctor. For the past year and a half, maybe a little longer, I’ve felt this crushing sadness, like a heavy blanket that won’t lift. Every night, the dreams are just… awful. Always the same, vivid nightmares that make it impossible to get any real rest. Even during the day, I just feel so slow, like trying to move through thick mud. It takes me forever to do anything, even simple things at work, which is a real problem when you're driving a subway.

And that’s not even the strangest part. About a year and seven months ago, things started to get really weird. I keep getting these terrible smells, like something’s burning or decaying, but no one else notices it. Then there are these thoughts… it's like the world is going to completely fall apart, any second now. I see signs of it everywhere, and I feel like a catastrophe is always just around the corner. Sometimes, when people are talking to me, my mind just goes off on a tangent and I can’t seem to answer their question directly. I also find myself sometimes just mimicking the gestures of people talking to me without even realizing it. And honestly, I just don't have the energy or motivation for anything I used to enjoy. It’s hard to even get myself out of bed most days. It's making it really hard to do my job, and even harder to just live my life.

D007-D005_h025.question:
It's like the world has just… flatlined, you know? Not that it's ending in a big bang, but more like it's quietly decaying, a slow, inevitable fade to nothing. Every morning, I wake up with this awful taste in my mouth, like ashes and rust, even though I haven't eaten anything. It's been going on for over a year and a half now, this constant sense of dread and emptiness. I used to love finding those hidden gems in the stacks at the library, the quiet satisfaction of putting a book back where it belonged. But now? There's just… nothing. No joy, no interest.

I try to explain it sometimes, but my thoughts just scatter. I'll start talking about the quiet decay and then suddenly I'm rambling about the dust motes in the sunlight by the history section, and it all just drifts away. It’s hard to focus. Sometimes, I just sit there, unmoving, for hours, completely disconnected from everything. Other times, though, I can't sit still at all. My hands are constantly fiddling, picking at my cuticles, pacing the small space of my apartment. It’s worse at night; the nightmares are relentless, always about the world dissolving, leaving me adrift. I feel so numb most of the time, like my feelings are wrapped in cotton wool. It's truly made it impossible to do my job properly; I just can't connect with anything or anyone.
